thread:
maya: Quick heads-up — I ran a slice and found ~900 accounts with onboarding_status=started but no handshake_event in CRM. That lines up with missing 1st-week healthscore signals. Can we scope a targeted sweep + a safe playbook automation to close the gap?
jordan: Can you paste the query and a few sample account_ids? I can spin up a dry-run job.
maya: Query: `SELECT id, deal_stage, onboarding_status, enablement_session_booked, last_activity FROM accounts WHERE onboarding_status='started' AND handshake_event IS NULL;` Samples: 10123, 10145, 10178. Also noticed `enablement_session_booked` is false for ~70% of them.
liam: Heads-up: several of those are still in AE pipeline. We shouldn't auto-send enablement invites for accounts where deal_stage != 'closed' or 'live'. AEs prefer to coordinate onboarding.
maya: Agreed. Proposed logic: backfill handshake_event from calendar/webhook logs where possible. For the automation: if deal_stage IN ('closed','live') AND enablement_session_booked=false -> send enablement invite + set handshake_event once accepted. Else add tag `needs_ae_touch`.
jordan: Plan: two-part run — (1) crm-backfill job that looks for calendar events / meeting webhooks and writes handshake_event (with source:cal-backfill) (2) cs-playbook to invite & tag. I'll implement with dry_run=true first.
onboard-bot: crm-backfill-handshake scheduled (dry-run) tonight 02:00 UTC. Will post report to #customer-success after run.
maya: Please include safety toggles: `skip_if(deal_stage NOT IN ('closed','live'))` and a max_rate limit for invites. Also ensure we only update handshake_event if calendar_match_confidence >= 0.8.
jordan: Good call — adding `confidence_threshold=0.8`, `max_invites_per_hour=200`, and `dry_run=true` default. Backfill will write candidate rows to S3 CSV for review before applying.
liam: :thumbsup: I'll let AE team know to mark carve-outs. Also request that automation respects `ae_owner` field — if set, add `needs_ae_touch` instead of sending.
maya: I'll draft a short note for AEs + one-pager for CS ops explaining the triggers and rollback steps. Will share in this thread by EOD.
jordan: After dry-run I'll post CSV and a small sample (50 rows) for sign-off. Who can approve tomorrow?
maya: I can review samples. @liam please confirm AE carve-outs before we flip live.
liam: Will review first thing AM and DM any carve-outs.
onboard-bot: crm-backfill-handshake dry-run completed. Summary: 912 candidates detected, 342 calendar matches >=0.8, sample CSV at s3://redwood-cs-backfill/2102468100/sample.csv — no writes performed in dry-run.
maya: Thanks — downloading sample now. If the sample looks good I'll sign off for a limited pilot (200 invites/hr) to start next week.
